items: UPS 2027 fee tables lift surcharges about 9%. UPS's published 2027 tables, effective Dec. 21, 2026, raise most of about 110 surcharges and services by a median of about 9%, against the 5.9% average net increase. Residential Ground goes to $7.10 from $6.50, remote area to $18.00 from $16.50, and Large Package (commercial, zone 2) to $250.00 from $219.50.

FedEx and Stripe plan SMB financing tool. FedEx Dataworks and Stripe will link FedEx shipment data with Stripe Capital financing for small and medium-sized businesses, with the first joint solution planned for early 2027. FedEx also plans to add Stripe as a payment option, introducing over 50 new payment methods globally.

Amazon starts Prime Air drone deliveries in Nampa. Amazon launched the service Friday for select customers and areas in Nampa, Idaho, using MK-30 drones to carry packages up to five pounds within 7.5 miles, in daytime hours only. Idaho News 6 reported the launch, and the source does not state fees.
